notes: TextMeshPro font atlases are built by a specific Unity Editor version and only load in games built with a compatible one - which is why a font bundle that works in one game shows blank boxes in the next. The bundle names below are the ones shipped in the XUnity.AutoTranslator TMP_Font_AssetBundles archive, mapped to the Unity ranges their filenames declare. Ranges marked `confidence: inferred` are gaps in upstream's naming, not documented facts.

source.note: Distributed as .7z. IndieDeck does not bundle a 7z decoder; it downloads the archive, then either uses a 7-Zip/7za binary found on PATH or hands the user the folder with instructions.

bundles.note: Upstream ships no u2020 bundle. The 2020.x line is mapped here as the nearest lower build; if text renders as boxes on a 2020.x game, try arialuni_sdf_u2021 next.
2023.x (and Unity 2023 LTS rebranded as Unity 6 previews) is mapped to the 2022 bundle; upstream ships nothing between u2022 and u6000.
Added in the v5.5.0 TMP_Font_AssetBundles refresh for Unity 6.

config.note: README recommends FallbackFontTextMeshPro over OverrideFontTextMeshPro so the game keeps its own font and only falls back for glyphs it cannot render.

alternative.note: Replaces every TMP font. Use only when the fallback path fails.

systemFontOption.note: TextMeshPro 3.2.0+ can load a system-installed font by name, which avoids asset-bundle version matching entirely.
